svg.title: Beijing Support - Brochure Reference
svg.desc: Source describes municipal support up to 30% of qualifying new-energy construction investment for medium/deep downhole exchange, with possible district support. It recommends consultation with the district development/reform authority and checking current application calls. This is a historical brochure reference, not confirmation of an available grant or eligibility.
